sections.heading: Welcome to Alifu Alifu Atoll
paragraphs: Alifu Alifu Atoll, also known as Ari Atoll, is one of the most popular atolls in the Maldives, renowned for its spectacular diving spots, luxury resorts, and breathtaking natural beauty. Located west of Malé, this atoll offers the perfect blend of accessibility and tropical paradise.

With its crystal-clear waters, vibrant coral reefs, and abundant marine life including whale sharks and manta rays, Alifu Alifu is a dream destination for divers and snorkelers. The atoll features some of the Maldives' most exclusive resorts, each offering world-class amenities and stunning overwater villas.

sections.heading: World-Class Dive Sites in Alifu Alifu
paragraphs: Famous cleaning station where majestic manta rays gather year-round, with peak season from May to November.
Depth: 5-20m | Level: Beginner-Intermediate | Season: Year-round (peak May-Nov)
One of the best places in the world to swim with gentle whale sharks, most commonly seen from August to November.
Depth: 5-30m | Level: All levels | Season: Year-round (peak Aug-Nov)

sections.heading: Adventure & Relaxation Activities
paragraphs: Swim with the ocean's gentle giants on guided snorkeling excursions to whale shark hotspots.
Evening boat trips to spot playful spinner dolphins against breathtaking Maldivian sunsets.
Pamper yourself with luxurious treatments in overwater spa pavilions with ocean views.

sections.heading: Visitor Experiences
paragraphs: Our stay at Conrad Maldives in Alifu Alifu was beyond magical. Swimming with whale sharks was the highlight of our trip - an experience we'll never forget. The underwater restaurant was worth every penny, with incredible food and marine life views. Can't wait to return!

Alifu Alifu's diving is world-class. We did 12 dives and saw mantas every time at Manta Point. The house reef at Veligandu Island Resort was teeming with life. Only reason for 4 stars was some coral bleaching we noticed, but the marine life was still abundant.
